summary: MMX capability detection with an HKLM registry override. Opens the registry key Software\Microsoft\Direct3D via RegOpenKeyA; if open succeeds it queries the value "DisableMMX" via RegQueryValueExA, and when that value is present as REG_DWORD (type 4) with a non-zero payload it closes the key and forces the cached state dword_5D7994 to 0 (MMX disabled), returning 0. Otherwise it closes the key and, only when the cached state dword_5D7994 is negative (uninitialized), runs CPU feature detection via sub_50FC58, emits the EMMS instruction (_m_empty) when MMX is available, and stores 1 (MMX enabled) or 0 into dword_5D7994. Returns the cached enable state dword_5D7994. Called from texture/render initialization paths.

local_names.Data: 4-byte buffer receiving the DisableMMX value data
local_names.Type: DWORD receiving the registry value type (compared against REG_DWORD = 4)
local_names.cbData: size in/out for the registry query (preset to 4)
local_names.dword_5D7994: cached MMX enable state: -1 uninitialized, 0 disabled, 1 enabled

operations.description: Guard: open HKLM subkey "Software\Microsoft\Direct3D" (SubKey) via RegOpenKeyA; proceed only when the call succeeds.
Preset cbData = 4, the size of a REG_DWORD value, before querying.
Call RegQueryValueExA(phkResult, ValueName "DisableMMX", 0, &Type, Data, &cbData) to read the override value.
Guard: when the query succeeds AND Type == 4 (REG_DWORD) AND the Data DWORD is non-zero, treat MMX as forcibly disabled.
Close the registry key via RegCloseKey(phkResult) on the forced-disable path.
Store dword_5D7994 = 0 to cache the forced MMX-disabled state.
Return 0 (MMX disabled) immediately after the registry-forced disable.
On the non-forced path close the opened registry key via RegCloseKey(phkResult).
Guard: run CPU detection only when the cached state dword_5D7994 is negative (uninitialized).
Seed dword_5D7994 = 0 before detection so the state is no longer uninitialized.
Call sub_50FC58() to run CPU MMX feature detection.
When detection reports MMX available, emit the EMMS instruction via the _m_empty() intrinsic.
Store dword_5D7994 = 1 to cache the MMX-enabled state after successful detection.
Return the cached state dword_5D7994 (0 disabled, 1 enabled).
Called from texture/render initialization paths: ImageTextureDecompressor, FunctionPointerSwitch, and RenderFeatureDispatch.

unresolved: _m_empty() is an MSVC intrinsic (EMMS instruction) with no discrete callee address, so it cannot carry a callee evidence ref.
The exact CPU feature check performed by sub_50FC58 is not visible in this function.
The owning rendering object that caches the MMX state in dword_5D7994 is unknown.
